content: Ibdurgan-swilidikmalad, degi, ibdurgan-swilidiksurmalad
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogded:
“Israel-dulemarga be sogmar: ‘Bela we-napneggi ibdurgan-bukwamalad-abargi, wemar be gunmaloed:
” ’Degi-inigwele, ibdurgan-gagan-masar, gannar-mabaliga sabanyagi mas saboged, amar-abargi goonasi-darbo-mararsurmalad gudidimogad. Amardi be gunnosulid. A-ibdurganmala, wemalad:

content.text: Moli-yargan-mureged, we-moli gagan-masar, gannar-mabaliga sabanyagi mas saboged, ar e-gonasidi, mararsulid.
Deginbali, nubi, gannar-mabaliga sabanyagi mas saboged, ar e-gonasidi, mararsulid.
Amba deyobi, ugdun, gannar-mabaliga sabanyagi mas saboged, ar e-gonasidi, mararsulid.
Deginbali, sina, goonasi-darbo-marar-nika-inigwele, gannar-mabaliga sabanyagi mas sabosulid.

content: ” ’We-sanmar be gunnosurmalad, deginbali, a-ibmar-burgwarmalad be ebugosurmarbalid. Bemar we-ibmarmar swilidiksuli dakoed.

content.text: Ar ibmar-dummagan, degi, ibmar-senigan-see-nikasurmalad, degi, uka-nikasurmalad, demargineddibe, diwargineddibe,

content: ” ’E-san bemar gunnosulid, deginbali, we-ibmar-burgwarmalad bemar ima-dakbaloed, ar ade, bemarga ibmar-swilidiksulidga guoed.
Bela ibmarmar-diigi-gudidimalad-see-nikasurmalad, degi, uka-nikasurmalad, bemarga ibmar-swilidiksulidga guoed.
” ’Bemar we-nuumar ima-dakoed, be gunnosurmalad, ar ade, we-nuumar bemarga swilidiksuli gued:
” ’Bela ibsenigan-gukumalad mali-walabakegwadgi-nanamalad, bemarga ibmar-swilidiksulidga guoed.
Degi-inigwele, ibsenigan-gukumalad mali-walabakegwadgi-nanamalad, ukinbali, ichomakega e-nag-sorbalid-bur-suigan nikamalad, be sunna gunmaloed.
Bemar we-ibmarmar sunna gunmaloed:

content.text: Ar bela ibsenigan-gukumalad-bamalad mali-walabakegwadgi-nanamalad, bemarga ibmar-swilidiksulidga guoed.’ ”

content: Ibmar-swilidiksurmalad-ebusad-igar
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “We-ibmarmar-ulale, bemar swilidiksuli gunonikoed.

content.text: Bela ibdurgan goonasi-mamararsulid, degi, mas gannar-mabaliga sabanyagi mas-sabosulidi,
Napagi ibmar-durgan-garmakdii-abargi, bemar we-ibdurgan swilidiksuli dakoed:
Napagi ibdurgan-garmakdii-abargi, we-ibdurgan bemar swilidiksuli dakoed.

content: Ibdurgan-swilidiksurmalad-ebusad-igar-bamalad
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “We-ibdurganmar-burgwaled we-ibmarmargi argwachale:

content.text: Ar gannar we-ibmarmar swilidik-guega, diigi enuklegergebed.

content: ”Napsa-bormo-yagi we-ibmarmar-burgwaled argwachale, we-napsa-bormo-yagi bela ibmar-bukwadi ibmar-swilidiksulidga gunonikoed. Degisoggu, we-napsa-bormo mamarilegoed.
We-napsa-bormogi-dii-siid ibmar-gullegedgi dedemaksale, we-ibmar-gulleged swilidikidsulidga gunonikoed. Deyobbalid, we-napsa-bormogi-dii-siid gobedgi dedemaksale, we-gobed swilidiksuli gunonikoed.

”We-ibmar-burgwaled ibmar-bamaladgi argwachale, we-ibmarmar bela ibmar-swilidiksulidga gunonikoed. Madu-yoedgi argwachadibe, soogi argwachadibe, we-ibmarmar swilidiksulidga gunonikoed. Degisoggu, we-madu-yoed mamarilegoed, degi, we-soo obelolegoed. We-ibmarmar swilidiksuli gunonikid. Degisoggu, bemar deyobi, we-ibmar dakoed.
”Degi-inigwele, unnila dian, degi, dii-sailagi bia dii-sulege, amarbi amba ibmar-swilidikidga guoed, gwen isguosulid. Ar dule we-ibmar-burgwaled-ebusaddi, swilidiksuli gunonikoed.
”Ar we-ibmar-burgwaled ibmar-gwag-diglesokalidgi argwachale, we-ibmar-gwag amba swilidik guoed.
Ar ibmar-gwaggi dii eolesardi, geb agi, we-ibmar-burgwaled egi argwachale, adi, we-ibmar-gwag swilidiksuli gunonikoed.
”Ibdurgan-nabir-gulleged burgwisale, ar doa-dule we-ibmar-burgwaled-ebusale, neg-mutikidse swilidiksuli gudii guoed.

Dule we-ibmar-burgwisad-e-san guchale, na e-mor enukoed. We-dule mutikidse swilidiksuli gudii guoed. Doa-dule we-ibmar-burgwisad magaba-onosale, na e-mor enukoed. We-dule mutikidse swilidiksuli gudii guoed.”
Napagi-ibdurgan-garmakdimalad ise-gullemalad
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi Aarónʼga sogdebalid: “Bemar napagi-ibdurgan-garmakmalad gunnosulid, ar ade, ibmar-swilidiksurmaladid.
”Ibdurgan-unimakar-nanamalad, e-mali-walabakegwadgi-nanamalad, degi, e-malimar-ichesulidgi-nanamalad, bemar gunnosurmalad, ar ade, swilidiksurmaladid.
Ibdurgan-unimakar-nanamalad-gunnedba mer be swilidiksuli gumalo, mer be isgumalo, ar we-ibdurganmar swilidiksuli gumalad.

”Ani, an-bemar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová gued. Ar an dule-isligwaledsoggu, bemar gwage-swilidik imakmalo, deyobi, bemar gwage-swilidik gudimalo. Ibdurgan-unimakar-nanamalad-gunnedba, degi, ebugedba, mer be swilidiksuli gumalo.
Ani an Bab-Jehová gued. Ani an Egipto-yargi bemar-onosad, adi, an be-Bab-Dummadga guegar. Degisoggu, bemar gwage-swilidik imakmala, ar an dule-islidikidid.
”Ibdurgansik, nuumarsik, bela ibdurgan-dii-yagi-gudidimaladsik, degi, bela ibdurgan-napagi-garmakdidimaladsik, weyob igarmar megisad.
Adi, bemar magar-dakega, igid ibmar-isgana-gue, igid ibmar-nuegan-gue. Deginbali, igid-ibdurgan nabir gullege, igid-ibdurgan ise gullebali.”
